The classic instant camera.

The classic analog instant camera. With self-timer and double-exposure modes, an upgraded two-lens autofocusing system and made with 40% recycled materials in different colors. All so you can capture real life on iconic, full-sized Polaroid film.

      Reviews

        Product info

        Features

        • Self-timer & double exposure modes
        • Classic look made of 40% recycled material
        • Accurate, human-friendly flash
        • Up to 15 film packs battery life
        • Tripod mount
        • Custom design shutter system, using precision step motor for shutter
        • Six useable apertures ranging from f64 to f11
        • Warranty coverage

        Compatible with

        • Polaroid i-Type film
        • Polaroid 600 film

        Dimensions

        • 150.2mm x 112.2mm x 94mm (5.91" x 4.42" x 3.7")
        • Weight: 448 grams (15.8oz)

        Battery

        • Lithium-ion battery

        Outer Shell

        • ABS, PC (40% recycled plastics)

        Lenses

        • Optical grade PC and Acrylic lens, coated
        • Autofocus system via 2 fixed focus zones (0.40m-1.3m; 1.0m-infinity)

        Field of View

        • Horizontal 40°, Vertical 41°

        Flash System

        • Vacuum discharge tube storage

        Packaging Content

        • Polaroid Now Instant Camera Generation 3
        • Wrist Strap
        • Quick Start Guide
        • Safety & Compliance Leaflet

        Proposition 65

        • For more information please check here.
